items.source:
You may specify any AOP Alliance MethodInterceptors or other
Spring AOP Advices, as well as Spring AOP Advisors.
items.translation: 您可以指定任何 AOP Alliance 方法拦截器或其他 Spring AOP 建议，以及 Spring AOP 顾问。

items.source: A hook for subclasses to post-process the ProxyFactory before creating the proxy instance with it.
items.translation: 子类在利用其创建代理实例之前，用于对 `ProxyFactory` 进行后处理的钩子。

items.source: Manages pre- and post-interceptors (references, rather than interceptor names, as in ProxyFactoryBean) and provides consistent interface management.
items.translation: 管理前置和后置拦截器（引用而非拦截器名称，如ProxyFactoryBean），并提供一致的接口管理。

items.source:
The target may be any object, in which case a SingletonTargetSource will
be created. If it is a TargetSource, no wrapper TargetSource is created:
This enables the use of a pooling or prototype TargetSource etc.
items.translation: 目标可以是任何对象，此时将创建一个 SingletonTargetSource。如果它是一个 TargetSource，则不会创建包装的 TargetSource：这使得可以使用池化或原型 TargetSource 等。

items.source:
If not specified (the default), the AOP infrastructure works
out which interfaces need proxying by analyzing the target,
proxying all the interfaces that the target object implements.
items.translation: 如果未指定（默认情况下），AOP 基础设施将通过分析目标对象来确定需要代理的接口，并为目标对象实现的所有接口创建代理。

items.source:
Default is the bean ClassLoader, i.e. the ClassLoader used by the
containing BeanFactory for loading all bean classes. This can be
overridden here for specific proxies.
items.translation: 默认值为 Bean ClassLoader，即包含该 BeanFactory 用于加载所有 Bean 类的 ClassLoader。此处可针对特定代理进行覆盖。

items.source:
Pre-interceptors will be applied before, post-interceptors
will be applied after this interceptor.
items.translation: 前置拦截器将在本拦截器之前应用，后置拦截器将在本拦截器之后应用。

items.source: Determine a TargetSource for the given target (or TargetSource).
items.translation: 为给定的目标（或 TargetSource）确定一个 TargetSource。

items.source:
Specify the AdvisorAdapterRegistry to use.
Default is the global AdvisorAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: 指定要使用的 AdvisorAdapterRegistry。默认值为全局 AdvisorAdapterRegistry。

items.source: target - the target. If this is an implementation of TargetSource it is used as our TargetSource; otherwise it is wrapped in a SingletonTargetSource.
items.translation: target - 目标。如果这是一个 TargetSource 的实现，则将其用作我们的 TargetSource；否则，将其包装在 SingletonTargetSource 中。

items.source: proxyFactory - the AOP ProxyFactory about to be used
items.translation: proxyFactory - 即将使用的 AOP ProxyFactory

items.source: a TargetSource for this object
items.translation: 该对象的 TargetSource

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口可以通过其SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype()方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通FactoryBean实现，如果isSingleton()实现返回 false，则假定其始终返回独立实例。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() method or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后但初始化回调（如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法或自定义 init-method）之前之前调用。

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，这支持单例和原型两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的 FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Description copied from interface: BeanClassLoaderAware
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：BeanClassLoaderAware

items.source: Description copied from interface: InitializingBean
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：InitializingBean

items.source: Description copied from interface: FactoryBean
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：FactoryBean

items.source: Description copied from interface: FactoryBean
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：FactoryBean

items.source: Description copied from interface: FactoryBean
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：FactoryBean

items.source: Is the object managed by this factory a singleton? That is, will FactoryBean.getObject() always return the same object (a reference that can be cached)?
items.translation: 该工厂管理的对象是单例吗？也就是说，FactoryBean.getObject() 是否总是返回同一个对象（一个可以缓存的引用）？

items.source: Callback that supplies the bean class loader to a bean instance.
items.translation: 向 Bean 实例提供 类加载器 的回调。

items.source: Return the type of object that this FactoryBean creates, or null if not known in advance.
items.translation: 返回此 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如果无法预先确定则返回 `null`。

items.source: Create the "main" interceptor for this proxy factory bean.
items.translation: 为此代理工厂 Bean 创建“主”拦截器。

items.source:
Return an instance (possibly shared or independent) of the object
managed by this factory.
items.translation: 返回由该工厂管理的对象的实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。

items.source: Specify the AdvisorAdapterRegistry to use.
items.translation: 指定要使用的 AdvisorAdapterRegistry。

items.source:
Set additional interceptors (or advisors) to be applied after the
implicit transaction interceptor.
items.translation: 设置额外的拦截器（或顾问），以便在隐式事务拦截器之后应用。

items.source:
Set additional interceptors (or advisors) to be applied before the
implicit transaction interceptor, for example, a PerformanceMonitorInterceptor.
items.translation: 设置额外的拦截器（或顾问）以在隐式事务拦截器之前应用，例如 PerformanceMonitorInterceptor。

items.source: Set the ClassLoader to generate the proxy class in.
items.translation: 将 ClassLoader 设置为生成代理类的类加载器。

items.source: Specify the set of interfaces being proxied.
items.translation: 指定被代理的接口集。

items.source: Set the target object, that is, the bean to be wrapped with a transactional proxy.
items.translation: 设置目标对象，即需要以事务代理包装的 Bean。

items.source: getObject in interface FactoryBean<Object>
items.translation: `getObject` 在接口 `FactoryBean<Object>` 中

items.source: getObjectType in interface FactoryBean<Object>
items.translation: `getObjectType` 在接口 `FactoryBean<Object>` 中

items.source: isSingleton in interface FactoryBean<Object>
items.translation: isSingleton 接口 FactoryBean<Object> 中

items.source: setBeanClassLoader in interface BeanClassLoaderAware
items.translation: `setBeanClassLoader` 接口 `BeanClassLoaderAware` 中

items.source: afterPropertiesSet in interface InitializingBean
items.translation: `afterPropertiesSet` 接口中的 `InitializingBean`

items.source: classLoader - the owning class loader
items.translation: classLoader - 拥有者类加载器

items.source: an instance of the bean (can be null)
items.translation: bean 的实例（可以为null）

items.source: the type of object that this FactoryBean creates, or null if not known at the time of the call
items.translation: 该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，或在调用时未知则为 `null`。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller

items.source: whether the exposed object is a singleton
items.translation: 已暴露的对象是否为单例
